title: SM-ECO-10060 member
description: One sovereign member of SM-ECO-10060, the jurisdiction layer for capital-markets issuer records: its code, its duty namespace, its canonical node, and the Allooloo node, record door, Agent Card and duty line it carries (null where no Allooloo node serves the market; the signal on any request is then ACM-404 NOT_FOUND).

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the member (EU for the European Union bloc).

allooloo_node.description: The Allooloo node that serves the market's issuer records (for example fr-cm-kg), or the bloc door for EU; null where no node serves the market.

record_door.description: The MCP door of that node; null where no node serves the market.

agent_card.description: The node's Agent Card; null where no node serves the market.

duty.description: The duty line as the node publishes it (list_nodes); null where no node serves the market.
